verses.en: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.
Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.
Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.
Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!
Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.

verses.he: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances. .
I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.
BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.
With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.

verses.he: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃
verses.en: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
Blessed art Thou, O LORD; Teach me Thy statutes.
With my lips have I told All the ordinances of Thy mouth.
I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
I will meditate in Thy precepts, And have respect unto Thy ways.
I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.
GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.
Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.

verses.he: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.en: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.
My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.
Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.

verses.he: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
verses.en: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.

verses.he: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.en: Even though princes sit and talk against me, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.
Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors. DALETH.
My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.
I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.
Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.
My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.
Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.
I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.
I will run the way of Thy commandments, For Thou dost enlarge my heart.

verses.he: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃
verses.en: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; And I will keep it at every step.
Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.
Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.
Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.

verses.he: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃
verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.
Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.
VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;
That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.

verses.he: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;
So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;
And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;

verses.he: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.he: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.en: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in Thy statutes.
ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, Because Thou hast made me to hope.

verses.he: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃
verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.

verses.he: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.
I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself. .
Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.
Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.he: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.en: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.
This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.
HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.
I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.
I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.
I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.

verses.he: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.en: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.

verses.he: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.

verses.he: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.

verses.he: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.en: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.
TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

verses.he: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃
verses.en: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in Thy commandments.

verses.he: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃
verses.en: Before I was afflicted, I did err; But now I observe Thy word.
Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me; But I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.

verses.he: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃
verses.en: Their heart is gross like fat; But I delight in Thy law.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I might learn Thy statutes.
The law of Thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.he: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.en: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.

verses.he: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.en: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.

verses.he: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃
verses.en: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me. .
Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, According to Thy promise unto Thy servant.
Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.

verses.he: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.en: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.
Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.

verses.he: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.
CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.

verses.he: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, Saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'

verses.he: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.en: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.

verses.he: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.en: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.he: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.
All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.

verses.he: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃
verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.
Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.
LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.

verses.he: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

verses.he: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
verses.en: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.

verses.he: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃
verses.en: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.he: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃
verses.en: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.
I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.

verses.he: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃
verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.

verses.he: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃
verses.en: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.
MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

verses.he: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃
verses.en: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.

verses.he: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃
verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For Thy testimonies are my meditation.
I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.

verses.he: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃
verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.
I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; For Thou hast instructed me.
How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.he: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃
verses.en: From Thy precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.
NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, To observe Thy righteous ordinances.
I am afflicted very much; Quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

verses.he: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.en: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Thine ordinances.

verses.he: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.

verses.he: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃
verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.

verses.he: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃
verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.he: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃
verses.en: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.
SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.
Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.
Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.
Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.
Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.

verses.he: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.
My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; And I am afraid of Thy judgments.
AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Leave me not to mine oppressors.
Be surety for Thy servant for good; Let not the proud oppress me.
Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.
Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.
I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
It is time for the LORD to work; They have made void Thy law.
Therefore I love Thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

verses.he: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃
verses.en: Therefore I esteem all [Thy] precepts concerning all things to be right; Every false way I hate.
PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for Thy commandments.
Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, As is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.
Order my footsteps by Thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Redeem me from the oppression of man, And I will observe Thy precepts.
Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; And teach me Thy statutes.

verses.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.en: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, Because they observe not Thy law.
TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, And upright are Thy judgments.
Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.
Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.

verses.he: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.en: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.
Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.
Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.
Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.he: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃
verses.en: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.
I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.
I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.
Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.

verses.he: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.en: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; Quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.
They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.
Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.

verses.he: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃
verses.en: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.
RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; For I do not forget Thy law.
Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; Quicken me according to Thy word.

verses.he: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃
verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not Thy statutes.
Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; Quicken me as Thou art wont.

verses.he: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.

verses.he: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
verses.en: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; Because they observed not Thy word.

verses.he: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.en: O see how I love Thy precepts; Quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.
The beginning of Thy word is truth; And all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.

verses.he: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃
verses.en: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.

verses.he: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃
verses.en: I rejoice at Thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love. .

verses.he: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.

verses.he: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃
verses.en: Great peace have they that love Thy law; And there is no stumbling for them.
I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, And have done Thy commandments.
My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

verses.he: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
verses.en: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; For all my ways are before Thee.

verses.he: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃
verses.en: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Thy word.
Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.

verses.he: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.en: Let my lips utter praise: Because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.

verses.he: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃
verses.en: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; For all Thy commandments are righteousness.
Let Thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen Thy precepts.
I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; And Thy law is my delight.
Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; And let Thine ordinances help me.

verses.he: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; For I have not forgotten Thy commandments.
